Resolves #18604

`Neo.list.plugin.Animate` gains an opt-in measured mode, the height twin of its fluid-width mode: `measureItemHeight: true` on the plugin with the owner's `itemHeight` null. `createItem` writes no inline height (an item stays as tall as its content) and renders hidden before the first measurement; the owner's settle pass (`createItems`, after its update resolved) triggers ONE batched `getDomRect(ids)` read, the tallest item becomes the plugin-level `rowHeight`, `rows` and every position derive from it, and `repositionItems` reveals. The plugin measures again once a resize's fluid widths or a record change's re-render have landed (the owner's `onStoreRecordChange` is wrapped the way `onStoreFilter` / `onStoreSort` are; `promiseUpdate` is the settle signal): an equal measurement repositions nothing, a grown row repositions, a resize that unwraps shrinks it back. No height is ever written into the items — a written height is what the next measurement would read. `hasFixedItemHeight` guards the mode the way `hasFixedItemWidth` guards width; the construct guard names both admitted shapes. `rowHeight` is a getter — the owner's LIVE `itemHeight` in fixed mode, the plugin-owned `measuredRowHeight` in measured mode — and every rect read carries a request token, so an answer overtaken by a newer read or a mode switch publishes nothing. Fixed mode is the shipped one, its style keys in the shipped order. `examples/list/animate` gets a "Measured rows" checkbox that switches the list between 200px rows and measured rows.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on real list + plugin instances, mounted, against a `getDomRect` stub keyed by record, plus a deferred-read stub the arm answers in the order it chooses; the owning trees `unit/list` + `unit/menu` 80/80 at ca0b58dbf7) → L3 required (AC-1's example half and AC-5's measured variant need the real DOM measurement — run locally in the browser through the repo's dev server: fixed = 15 cards at `height: 200px` inline over 128px of content, row 1 at `translate(10px, 220px)`; measured = 15 cards at 140px natural height, no inline height, none hidden, row 1 at `translate(10px, 160px)`; back to fixed = 200px inline again; no console errors in any state). Residual: none, Residual-Owner: none.

Intake: a self-authored ticket (2026-09-12, the Institution roster's `itemHeight: 126` over 78px of content, neomjs/neo-agent-institution#128); the drift probe on `src/list/plugin/Animate.mjs`, `src/list/Base.mjs` and the plugin's SCSS since creation was empty at `dev@3044d7f86b`. Contract Ledger: on the ticket, revised at implementation.

## Deltas from ticket
- Fix 2 loses the height write-back: the ticket's first draft wrote the measured height back into the items; a written height is what the next measurement reads — `height` blinds growth, `min-height` blinds shrink (a wider pane that unwraps text would keep the old, taller rows: the #128 gap back after a dock resize). An item stays its content's height; the row height is the plugin's number. The ticket was revised before this PR opened.
- The first pass renders hidden (`visibility: hidden`) instead of positioning by a "last known" row height that does not exist yet; the first measurement reveals through `repositionItems`.
- The settle trigger is the owner's `createItems` event (fired after `promiseUpdate` resolves), so load, sort and filter all measure through one path; a record change measures through a wrap of `owner.onStoreRecordChange` (`list.Base` binds its store listeners by name, the `onStoreFilter` / `onStoreSort` precedent); a font-load or theme delivery has no hook today and stays out.
- `promiseUpdate` parks until the owner is mounted, so the measured arms run on a mounted fixture (`createFixture({mounted: true})`); the fixed-mode arms stay unmounted as before.
- R1 (both folded in ca0b58dbf7): `rowHeight` was a construct-time snapshot of the owner's `itemHeight`, so a fixed-mode consumer changing 126 → 200 got 200px items on 126px rows — it is a getter over the owner's live height now, with the measured value in a plugin-owned `measuredRowHeight`; and `measureRows` checked the mode only before its await, so a read overtaken by a mode switch or a newer read still published — every read takes a token, a switch takes one, a stale answer is dropped.
- Out of scope and untouched: variable per-row heights (stage two), masonry, the roster's own surface.

- `unit/list` + `unit/menu` 80/80 at ca0b58dbf7 (`menu.List` loads the plugin).
- Browser (dev server, `examples/list/animate`): the three states above, measured through the page's DOM (`offsetHeight`, inline `style`, `transform`), no console errors.

- [ ] `examples/list/animate` in the browser: sort and filter under "Measured rows" animate exactly as under fixed rows.
